title: Zombified Bait
text:
Walkthrough

A large pool of water features a corpse which is drowned in the middle of the lake. You have to jump on it, and another human mindlessly plunges into the water, providing you a second platform to jump across, which is that human. After reaching to the other side, you have to drag one of the bodies. You will then reach to a crushing trap, so release the body to the pit, then proceed forward.
